text: I want to warn people about Turkish Airlines. I had a domestic flight from Harbin to Beijing, then my connection to Istanbul. Since the first flight was delayed, I missed my connecting flight. The staff at the counter refused to take responsibility, and I ended up sleeping in the terminal. They told me the next day that economy was overbooked and said I'd have to wait days or pay for business class. I had to be in Istanbul, so I paid. I'm still fuming and honestly in disbelief about Turkish.
